text:
sam: Hi all, first-day snag. Okta says I'm active but when I try to access CS tools it forces device-trust loop. I enrolled on my Mac but the browser keeps prompting for a passkey. Anyone seen this? @elaine

elaine: Welcome Sam! :wave: Can you confirm which browser and version? Also did you accept the device trust email from Okta?

sam: Using Chrome 120.0. I clicked the accept link and it opened okta verify but then browser kept asking for a passkey and wouldn't finish. Tried clearing cookies.

it-ops: Hey Sam — sometimes Chrome's profile-managed passkeys interfere. Two quick checks: (1) try in an incognito window, (2) try Safari/Firefox. If still stuck, we can temporarily exempt your session so you can finish onboarding.

sam: Incognito fails the same. Safari gets farther but then shows "No security key found" when I plug in YubiKey. I haven't added my YubiKey to 1Password onboarding vault yet.

provision-bot: [system] Device trust policy: Last provisioning run 2026-03-23T14:10Z returned 409 for device record create.

it-ops: Hmm 409 explains conflicts. @elaine I'm going to wipe the pending device record for sam and re-run enrollment. Sam, can you hold while I do that (should be <5m)?

sam: Yep holding. Also I can't see my redwood mailbox in the Gmail app yet — I can access the welcome doc in Drive though.

elaine: People Ops shows your mailbox created but sync to app could lag. Drive ok means GSuite account exists.

it-ops: Done — removed stale device record and retriggered enrollment. Try Safari again and plug in the YubiKey when prompted.

sam: Plugged in, macOS shows a confirmation prompt for the YubiKey. After confirming, okta says "Enrollment complete". :tada:

sam: Gmail app still not showing account on iPhone. Do I need to re-add account or wait?

it-ops: Try Settings > Mail > Accounts > Add Account and use corporate SSO, but if it still doesn't show, let me know and we'll push a re-sync. Also please upload your SSH pubkey and YubiKey serial (optional) into the 1Password onboarding item "Device and keys - onboarding" and tag @devops.

sam: Uploaded SSH key and a photo of YubiKey serial to 1Password item. Thanks. Quick intro: my onboarding buddy is @ashley per People Ops.

elainE: (typo) — meant to say welcome again! If anything else blocks your checklist ping me or @it-ops.

sam: Thanks everyone, excited to get started :rocket:
